required_semantics: pToday anchors recent, prior-month, and prior-year periods.
Dates from the three periods are mapped to a common relative day X-axis.
Recent profit ratio is visually separated from prior-month and prior-year profit ratios.
PR Today and PR Yesterday use FIXED calculations independent of the trend view grain.
The KPI card displays current profit ratio, day-over-day difference, direction, and anchor date.
observable_assertions: The workbook contains pToday with default 2025-02-04.
All twelve calculations in the dependency chain exist.
The trend worksheet uses a synchronized dual axis and excludes null period groups.
The KPI worksheet includes PR Today, PR Difference, direction, and pToday.
The dashboard contains both required worksheets.
allowed_differences: A text mark may replace the transparent custom shape because the shape does not alter the KPI value.
Exact dash pattern, line markers, fonts, colors, padding, and tooltip prose may differ.
The intermediate calculation-table worksheet need not be included in the final dashboard.
